raw_segments.text: Going into lies, he found her half reclining in the invalid chair, in which she had been
wheeled when she was unable to walk. She did not move to meet him, but her sharp, keen
eyes were simply riveted on his face. There was a feverish look in her eyes, her face
was pale and yellow. Alyosha was amazed at the change that had taken place in her in
three days. She was positively thinner. She did not hold out her hand to him.
He touched the thin, long fingers which lay motionless on her dress. Then he sat down
